text.en:
Door-to-Door Household Removals — UK to Turkey | Hanbros UK — Leader in UK–Turkey Logistics

Moving home from the United Kingdom to Turkey? Hanbros UK leads the market in door-to-door household removals — professional packing, secure loading, customs clearance and delivery to your new Turkish address.

We understand that emigration or retirement moves involve more than logistics: they carry memories, family heirlooms and life's possessions. Our crews use export-grade materials, inventory every item and coordinate Transfer of Residence relief where you qualify — reducing duty on personal effects.

Our Household Removal Services Include

  • Full packing service: Bubble wrap, blankets, export cartons and furniture dismantling.
  • Part-load & full-load: From a few rooms to an entire house.
  • Storage options: Short-term UK or transit storage if your Turkish home is not ready.
  • White goods & furniture: Safe handling of fridges, sofas, beds and fragile items.
  • Customs & ToR: Personal effects declarations and Turkish import clearance included.

Why choose Hanbros UK? We are not a generic freight forwarder — we are built exclusively for the United Kingdom to Turkey corridor, with bilingual staff, transparent pricing and thousands of satisfied customers.

Frequently Asked Questions

How long does a household move to Turkey take?

Typically 10–21 days door-to-door depending on load size, route (road or sea) and customs processing.

Can I ship used furniture and appliances?

Yes — used personal effects are common. We advise on Turkish import rules and any items that may attract duty.

Do you offer a pre-move survey?

Yes — free video or in-home surveys for accurate volume estimates and fixed quotes.

Hanbros UK — England origin. Turkey delivered. Request your free quote today on hanbroscargo.co.uk.
